item.description: Marine heat waves are a consequence of climate change and are increasingly altering marine and coastal regions worldwide. The effect is particularly pronounced in polar and subpolar shelf seas of the Northern Hemisphere, where sea ice is declining as temperatures rise. Fuente: Phys.org.
